name: Lunchbox
summary: Open plastic lunchbox with sandwich, apple and carrot, or a stacked steel tiffin carrier; for school lunch scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the box rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the lunchbox is hero size (~440 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: variant
params.note: box = plastic lunchbox open to show food; tiffin = stacked 3-tier steel carrier (always steel)

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
